blind.description: An antique wooden bureau / secretary desk with its writing flap open. It features a top gallery rail with ornate brass fencing, small interior organizer compartments and cubbies with tiny drawer pulls, an open fold-down desk surface lined with a dark leather inlay, two lower drawers with brass bail handles, and four corner bracket feet.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a layered rectangular structure: a narrow top rectangular shelf with a brass edge railing, stepping down into an open slanted cavity, and an extended horizontal rectangular writing surface with a dark inlay panel and brass hardware fixtures.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in scale figure (around 3 ft tall) and roughly 2.5 to 3 ft wide.
